name: "Pepperoni Pizza" Grilled Cheese Sandwich with Fruit Salad (Kid-Friendly)

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lemon
½ (16 oz) pkg strawberries
1 Gala apple
1 (6 oz) pkg blueberries

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add sugar and stir to combine.
Trim and quarter strawberries. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice and sugar.
Quarter, core, and medium dice apple. Add to the bowl, along with blueberries, then stir to combine the fruit salad. Set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, place half of the bread slices on a flat surface. Top each with one slice of cheese, 2 tablespoons of marinara sauce, pepperoni, and a second slice of cheese. Cover sandwiches with the remaining bread slices.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 slice white bread
8 slice mozzarella cheese, sliced
½ cup pizza sauce
2 oz pepperoni

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, place sandwiches in the skillet and cook until the bottoms are golden brown, 2-4 minutes.

Remove the sandwiches to a plate and add more butter to the skillet. Return sandwiches to the skillet, browned-side up, and cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes more. Once done, transfer to a cutting board and slice in half.
To serve, divide fruit salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!
